source.body:
# Protected RETALLY backlog consolidation

**Baseline:** 205 open PRs initially found in P00NSMASHER/github-value-hunt-ledger at audit start on October 31, 2026. **Live audit refresh:** 131 owner-authored and 72 automatically generated, **203 open now**; background activity may change these counts. This issue records the exact initial inventory and the live subset below.

**Safe rules:** never bulk-merge financial code, customers' evidence, stacked research, or draft implementations; preserve original commits, actual cash/noncash distinctions, independent CI and branch protections. Automated scout queue updates are proposals only, not proof of a researched or integrated source. Supersede repetitive same-file generated PR snapshots but retain full PR discussion history and latest queue version. No branch deletion, schedule change, external contact, payments or deployments.

**Latest snapshots to retain for inspection:** HUNTER-01 #895; HUNTER-04 #860; HUNTER-05 #886; HUNTER-06 #891; HUNTER-07 #896; HUNTER-08 #829; HUNTER-09 #847; HUNTER-10 #831; HUNTER-11 #854; HUNTER-12 #833; HUNTER-13 #897; HUNTER-14 #835; digest #836; technology #850.

**Review order:** (A) financial authorization/RLS/real PostgreSQL; (B) first-customer contracts and security; (C) freight research Lab 14 source provenance; (D) RecoveryOS backups, staging and deployment; (E) speculative/revenue experiments; (F) generated scout proposal rollups.

## Retally PR backlog checkpoint, November 1, 2026

**Live open PRs: 55**, down from the initial 205. Only #931 is non-draft; the other 54 are explicit draft holds (17 main-based, 37 stacked). The 150 reduction includes protected merges, supersession and archival closures, NOT 150 production features.

- Protected #926 restored durable fail-closed OCI E2 Micro launch-attempt locking.
- Protected #927 merged source integrity protections (main 3702a75b22a549a64b3bcc958549454f025d796a) with 96 synthetic authenticated role checks and independent bank/settlement proof hold preserved. Historical #493, #516, #924, #925 closed as source-superseded without branch deletion.
- Historical #313 closed after verifying all 17 named D1 reconciliation tests remain on main, plus expanded case/retention controls; historical #307 closed as outdated Cloudflare Email Sending proposal replaced by Resend with UUID provider acceptance. Neither closure proves real inbox delivery.
- Open #931 introduces nine narrow public claim blockers, 35 original adversarial cases, and distinct safeguards for the actual RecoveryOS disclosure page and the intentionally replaced /recoveryos/ Group noindex redirect. Repository Release Gate, Freight Commercial Contracts, Public Sites, Visual Acceptance, Customer Evidence Truth, and Main-Only Policy passed. RecoveryWorks Windows encrypted-backup suite remains RUNNING; do not report #931 merged before complete exact-head CI.
- Draft #929 old first-customer module replay has 272 failures and 7 errors from substantive API/financial authority conflicts, so remains NO MERGE. Draft #928 research (8 Golden Goose) and draft #930 (43 Lab14) preserve originals for review only, not commercial approval.

Release protections unchanged: no admin bypass, auto customer financial claims, external outreach, Oracle create, spending, customer-data import, or claim of realized recoveries. Keep source branches and original discussions.
